entity: the Bodmer Lab (bodmerlab.unige.ch), a research and digitization project of the University of Geneva's Faculty of Letters and the Fondation Martin Bodmer, supported by the Fondation Ernst and Lucie Schmidheiny: a digital library of world literature from the Bibliotheca Bodmeriana, organized in 'constellations', one of them the Bodmer Papyri, an online catalogue of the Fondation's papyrus and parchment manuscripts; formalized in the Revelation First meta-aggregator record of 2026-10-30 (https://www.revelationfirst.com/aggregators/bodmer-lab/). Distinct from Rolf Bodmer's cardiovascular laboratory at Sanford Burnham Prebys (bodmerlab.org) and the University of Salford's Bodmer Laboratories, two homonyms the composition sets beside it
row_type: C (a public entity on which the archive bears: a digital library and online papyrus catalogue; an entity of the Revelation First meta-aggregator)

classes_note: Three classes, each the census's own intersection, kind, text object or evidence kind for the entity, stated by field sources at the loci given: (1) the Bodmer papyri, the manuscripts the entity's constellation catalogues (census kind and text_object; B4, B10, B12), P66, P72 and P75 named among them by Wikipedia (B12), PB 2 = P.Bodmer II by the constellation's own numbering (B4); (2) early New Testament papyri (census intersection 'papyrology-discovery' and worked question 'papyri-revelation-date'; B4, B12); (3) digitized manuscript images and online catalogues (census evidence_kind 'manuscript images', 'catalogue or metadata', worked question 'seen-or-edited'; B1, B4, B7, B10). The archive bears on these classes through the Revelation First thesis (#202 and the deposits revelationfirst.com cites), its papyrological work (the Sappho papyri are Oxyrhynchus papyri, not Bodmer) and its machine-reading work; a deposit enters only where its sentence says something of the entity or applies its category to one of these classes. The census's rf_intersection ('Papyrological inversion: the Bodmer papyri include some of the earliest New Testament papyri ...') is the archive's reading, ledgered as RF-; it does not by itself admit a deposit. Aliases: the name with and without the space (the site's own 'bodmerlab'), the site's host, and the constellation's name. The bare 'Bodmer' is not an alias: it is Martin Bodmer, the Fondation, Rolf Bodmer and Sir Walter Bodmer; 'Bodmer Lab' at bodmerlab.org is the homonym, Rolf Bodmer's laboratory, and archive uses of that sense are read as the homonym's. Admission by reading (§3.4): a bare mention, a reference-list entry or a keyword is not a claim.
